<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><base href="https://themes.inneranimalmedia.com/theme-packages/ember/2.6.13/preview/">
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport">
<title>Ember Supply — Ember</title>
<!-- Premium Typography -->


<style type="text/css">@font-face {font-family:'Bebas Neue';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(/cf-fonts/s/bebas-neue/5.2.7/latin/400/normal.woff2);unicode-range:U+0000-00FF,U+0131,U+0152-0153,U+02BB-02BC,U+02C6,U+02DA,U+02DC,U+0304,U+0308,U+0329,U+2000-206F,U+20AC,U+2122,U+2191,U+2193,U+2212,U+2215,U+FEFF,U+FFFD;font-display:swap;}@font-face {font-family:'Bebas Neue';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(/cf-fonts/s/bebas-neue/5.2.7/latin-ext/400/normal.woff2);unicode-range:U+0100-02BA,U+02BD-02C5,U+02C7-02CC,U+02CE-02D7,U+02DD-02FF,U+0304,U+0308,U+0329,U+1D00-1DBF,U+1E00-1E9F,U+1EF2-1EFF,U+2020,U+20A0-20AB,U+20AD-20C0,U+2113,U+2C60-2C7F,U+A720-A7FF;font-display:swap;}</style>
<style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --black: #0a0a0a;
            --steel: #1a1a1a;
            --asphalt: #2a2a2a;
            --smoke: #8a8a8a;
            --light-smoke: #b0b0b0;
            --light-gray: #f0f0f0;
            --off-white: #f8f8f8;
            --white: #ffffff;
            --fire-orange: #ff4500;
            --racing-red: #dc143c;
            --louisiana-gold: #FFD700;
            --bronze: #CD7F32;
            --bronze-light: #E5A558;
            --bronze-dark: #9B5F1F;

            /* Typography */
            --font-display: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'Space Mono', monospace;

            /* Spacing */
            --space-xs: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1rem);
            --space-sm: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.5rem);
            --space-md: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem);
            --space-lg: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5rem);
            --space-xl: clamp(4rem, 9vw, 7rem);

            /* Border Radius */
            --radius: 12px;

            /* Ember Specific Variables */
            --Ember-ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
            --Ember-header: 80px;
            --Ember-header-md: 70px;
            --Ember-maxw: 1440px;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background-color: var(--black);
            color: var(--white);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            line-height: 1.6;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
            -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
        }

        /* ===== HEADER STYLES ===== */
        .Ember-shell {
            --Ember-ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
            --Ember-bronze: #CD7F32;
            --Ember-bronze-light: #E5A558;
            --Ember-bronze-dark: #9B5F1F;
            --Ember-ink: #fff;
            --Ember-muted: #c8cdd2;
            --Ember-orange: #ff4500;
            --Ember-bg0: #0a0a0a;
            --Ember-bg1: #141414;
            --Ember-bg2: #1f1f1f;
            --Ember-header: 80px;
            --Ember-header-md: 70px;
            --Ember-maxw: 1440px;
        }

        .Ember-shell * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        /* HERO gradient only (no global bleed) */
        .Ember-shell .Ember-bg-grad {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 72% 24%, rgba(255,69,0,.09) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 66%, rgba(229,165,88,.06) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at bottom, rgba(212,165,116,.04) 0%, transparent 65%),
                linear-gradient(180deg, var(--Ember-bg0) 0%, var(--Ember-bg1) 55%, var(--Ember-bg2) 100%);
        }

        /* ---------- Header (dark everywhere) ---------- */
        .Ember-header {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0 0 auto 0;
            height: var(--Ember-header);
            z-index: 10000;
            background: rgba(10,10,10,.86);
            box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,69,0,.06);
            transition: transform .28s var(--Ember-ease), backdrop-filter .28s var(--Ember-ease), background-color .28s var(--Ember-ease);
            will-change: transform;
        }

        @supports(backdrop-filter:blur(1px)) {
            .Ember-header {
                backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            }
            .Ember-header.is-scrolling {
                backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            }
        }

        .Ember-header.is-hidden {
            transform: translateY(-100%);
        }

        .Ember-row {
            max-width: var(--Ember-maxw);
            margin: 0 auto;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 0 56px;
        }

        .Ember-logo {
            height: 68px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            text-decoration: none;
            position: relative;
            transition: transform .25s var(--Ember-ease);
        }

        .Ember-logo img {
            height: 100%;
            width: auto;
            display: block;
            filter: brightness(.96);
            transition: filter .25s var(--Ember-ease);
        }

        .Ember-logo::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 50%;
            bottom: -6px;
            transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0);
            width: 100%;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--Ember-orange), transparent);
            transition: transform .3s var(--Ember-ease);
        }

        .Ember-logo:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .Ember-logo:hover img {
            filter: brightness(1.1) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,69,0,.4));
        }

        .Ember-logo:hover::after {
            transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1);
        }

        /* Desktop nav (hover/underline everywhere, only current underlined) */
        .Ember-nav {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            gap: 44px;
        }

        .Ember-nav a {
            color: var(--Ember-muted);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 15px;
            letter-spacing: .08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 700;
            position: relative;
            outline: none;
        }

        .Ember-nav a::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: -4px;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--Ember-orange), var(--Ember-bronze-light));
            transform: scaleX(0);
            transition: transform .25s var(--Ember-ease);
            transform-origin: center;
        }

        .Ember-nav a:hover,
        .Ember-nav a.is-active,
        .Ember-nav a:focus-visible {
            color: var(--Ember-ink);
        }

        .Ember-nav a:hover::before,
        .Ember-nav a.is-active::before,
        .Ember-nav a:focus-visible::before {
            transform: scaleX(1);
        }

        /* Burger + Mobile menu with matching underline */
        .Ember-burger {
            display: none;
            background: none;
            border: 0;
            padding: 10px;
            cursor: pointer;
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }

        .Ember-burger span {
            display: block;
            width: 24px;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--Ember-orange);
            margin: 5px 0;
            transition: transform .25s, opacity .25s;
        }

        .Ember-burger.is-open span:nth-child(1) {
            transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 6px);
        }

        .Ember-burger.is-open span:nth-child(2) {
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .Ember-burger.is-open span:nth-child(3) {
            transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(6px, -6px);
        }

        .Ember-mobile {
            position: fixed;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            top: var(--Ember-header);
            background: rgba(15,15,15,.98);
            transform: translateY(-100%);
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: transform .28s var(--Ember-ease), opacity .28s;
            z-index: 9999;
            padding: 22px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,69,0,.14);
        }

        .Ember-mobile.is-open {
            transform: translateY(0);
            opacity: 1;
            visibility: visible;
        }

        .Ember-mobile ul {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 20px;
            margin: 0;
        }

        .Ember-mobile a {
            color: var(--Ember-ink);
            text-decoration: none;
            letter-spacing: .08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 800;
            position: relative;
            outline: none;
            padding: 8px 0;
        }

        .Ember-mobile a::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: -2px;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--Ember-orange), var(--Ember-bronze-light));
            transform: scaleX(0);
            transition: transform .25s var(--Ember-ease);
            transform-origin: center;
        }

        .Ember-mobile a:focus-visible::before,
        .Ember-mobile a:active::before,
        .Ember-mobile a.is-active::before,
        .Ember-mobile a.tap-anim::before {
            transform: scaleX(1);
        }

        /* ===== HERO SECTION ===== */
        .Ember-hero {
            position: relative;
            min-height: 460px;
            height: 60dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .Ember-hero .wrap {
            max-width: var(--Ember-maxw);
            height: 100%;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 56px;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .Ember-left {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 16px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-top: min(7vh, 84px);
        }

        .Ember-title {
            font-size: clamp(38px, 5.6vw, 78px);
            line-height: .94;
            letter-spacing: -.02em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--Ember-ink);
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(20px);
        }

        .Ember-title span:first-child {
            display: block;
            font-size: .46em;
            color: #a7adb4;
            letter-spacing: .16em;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .Ember-title strong {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--Ember-orange) 0%, var(--Ember-bronze-light) 45%, var(--Ember-orange) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        .Ember-copy {
            max-width: 640px;
            color: #b9c0c6;
            font-size: 18px;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(16px);
        }

        .Ember-cta {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-top: 8px;
            padding: 12px 26px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            background: var(--Ember-bronze);
            color: #fff;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: .1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            border: 2px solid var(--Ember-bronze);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(205,127,50,.22);
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(12px);
        }

        .Ember-cta svg {
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
        }

        .Ember-cta:where(:hover, :focus-visible) {
            background: var(--Ember-bronze-dark);
            transform: translateY(8px);
        }

        /* GLB "statue" accent (consistent top-right) */
        .Ember-glb {
            position: absolute;
            top: -8%;
            right: -10%;
            width: clamp(170px, 20vw, 280px);
            height: clamp(170px, 20vw, 280px);
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(18px) scale(.9);
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.28));
        }

        .Ember-glb::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: -40% -40% -40% -40%;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(255,69,0,.05) 0%, transparent 60%);
            filter: blur(90px);
            opacity: .42;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .Ember-glb model-viewer {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: transparent;
            --poster-color: transparent;
            --progress-bar-color: rgba(255,69,0,.18);
            --progress-bar-height: 1px;
            --progress-mask: transparent;
            display: block;
            filter: brightness(.42) saturate(.6) contrast(1.2);
        }

        /* One-time entrance */
        .Ember-shell.is-hero-visible .Ember-title {
            animation: EmberUp .7s var(--Ember-ease) .05s forwards;
        }

        .Ember-shell.is-hero-visible .Ember-copy {
            animation: EmberUp .7s var(--Ember-ease) .16s forwards;
        }

        .Ember-shell.is-hero-visible .Ember-cta {
            animation: EmberUp .7s var(--Ember-ease) .28s forwards;
        }

        .Ember-shell.is-hero-visible .Ember-glb {
            animation: EmberPop .9s var(--Ember-ease) .18s forwards;
        }

        .Ember-title strong {
            position: relative;
        }

        .Ember-shell.is-hero-visible .Ember-title strong::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: -6px;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--Ember-orange), var(--Ember-bronze-light), transparent);
            animation: EmberSweep .9s var(--Ember-ease) .32s both;
        }

        @keyframes EmberUp {
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes EmberPop {
            50% {
                opacity: .5;
                transform: translateY(0) scale(1.02);
            }
            100% {
                opacity: .35;
                transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
            }
        }

        @keyframes EmberSweep {
            0% {
                transform: scaleX(0);
            }
            100% {
                transform: scaleX(1);
            }
        }

        /* Spacer for non-home pages */
        .Ember-spacer {
            height: var(--Ember-header);
            display: none;
        }

        /* ===== MAIN CONTENT SECTIONS ===== */

        /* Manifesto Section */
        .manifesto {
            padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-sm);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg,
                #3a3a3a 0%,
                #4a4a4a 20%,
                #6a6a6a 50%,
                #9a9a9a 80%,
                var(--off-white) 100%);
            position: relative;
        }

        .manifesto-container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: var(--space-lg);
            align-items: center;
        }

        .manifesto-content {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-40px);
        }

        .manifesto-content.visible {
            animation: slideRight 0.8s ease forwards;
        }

        .manifesto-title {
            font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
            line-height: 0.95;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .manifesto-title .highlight {
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            position: relative;
        }

        .manifesto-text {
            font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
            line-height: 1.7;
            color: var(--light-smoke);
            margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
        }

        .manifesto-text strong {
            color: var(--white);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .manifesto-visual {
            position: relative;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(40px);
        }

        .manifesto-visual.visible {
            animation: slideLeft 0.8s ease forwards;
        }

        .manifesto-image-container {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            padding-bottom: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        }

        .manifesto-image {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            object-position: center;
            filter: grayscale(100%);
            transition: filter 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease;
        }

        .manifesto-visual:hover .manifesto-image {
            filter: grayscale(0%);
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        /* Collections Section */
        .collections {
            padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-sm);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg,
                var(--off-white) 0%,
                var(--light-gray) 30%,
                #e0e0e0 60%,
                #d0d0d0 100%);
        }

        .collections-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
        }

        .collections-badge {
            font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
            font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
        }

        .collections-title {
            font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 4.5rem);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
            color: var(--black);
        }

        .collections-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
            gap: 2rem;
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .collection-card {
            position: relative;
            aspect-ratio: 3/4;
            background: var(--white);
            overflow: hidden;
            cursor: pointer;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(40px);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
        }

        .collection-card.visible {
            animation: fadeUpStagger 0.6s ease forwards;
        }

        .collection-card:nth-child(2) {
            animation-delay: 0.1s;
        }

        .collection-card:nth-child(3) {
            animation-delay: 0.2s;
        }

        .collection-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-10px);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
        }

        .collection-image {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            object-position: center;
            transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .collection-card:hover .collection-image {
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }

        .collection-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            padding: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem) clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.95), rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 30%, transparent);
            transform: translateY(10px);
            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
        }

        .collection-card:hover .collection-overlay {
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .collection-name {
            font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.25rem);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .collection-description {
            font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1rem);
            color: var(--light-smoke);
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .collection-link {
            font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 0.875rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--fire-orange);
        }

        /* Values Section with Glass to Solid Animation */
        .values {
            padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-sm);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg,
                #d0d0d0 0%,
                #a0a0a0 30%,
                var(--asphalt) 60%,
                var(--steel) 100%);
        }

        .values-container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .values-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
        }

        .values-title {
            font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 4.5rem);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .values-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem);
        }

        .value-card {
            padding: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem) clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(30px);
        }

        .value-card.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .value-card.solid {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
            backdrop-filter: blur(0px);
            border-color: var(--fire-orange);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(255,69,0,0.15);
        }

        .value-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-10px);
        }

        .value-number {
            font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
            font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1rem);
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .value-title {
            font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2rem);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .value-description {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.125rem);
            line-height: 1.6;
            color: var(--light-smoke);
        }

        /* Community Section with Enhanced Animations */
        .community {
            padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-sm);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg,
                var(--steel) 0%,
                var(--asphalt) 30%,
                #4a4a4a 60%,
                var(--light-gray) 100%);
        }

        .community-container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .community-title {
            font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 4.5rem);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .community-subtitle {
            font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 2.5vw, 1.375rem);
            color: var(--light-smoke);
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto var(--space-lg);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .community-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
        }

        .community-feature {
            padding: clamp(2rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            opacity: 0;
            transform: rotateY(-90deg) translateZ(100px);
            transform-style: preserve-3d;
            backface-visibility: hidden;
        }

        .community-feature.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: rotateY(0) translateZ(0);
        }

        .community-feature:nth-child(1).visible {
            animation: flipInUnique1 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards;
        }

        .community-feature:nth-child(2).visible {
            animation: flipInUnique2 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.1s forwards;
        }

        .community-feature:nth-child(3).visible {
            animation: flipInUnique3 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.2s forwards;
        }

        .community-feature:nth-child(4).visible {
            animation: flipInUnique4 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.3s forwards;
        }

        @keyframes flipInUnique1 {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: perspective(1000px) rotateY(-90deg) translateX(-50px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: perspective(1000px) rotateY(0) translateX(0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes flipInUnique2 {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: perspective(1000px) rotateX(90deg) translateY(-50px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: perspective(1000px) rotateX(0) translateY(0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes flipInUnique3 {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: perspective(1000px) rotateY(90deg) translateX(50px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: perspective(1000px) rotateY(0) translateX(0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes flipInUnique4 {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: perspective(1000px) rotateX(-90deg) translateY(50px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: perspective(1000px) rotateX(0) translateY(0);
            }
        }

        .community-feature:hover {
            transform: translateY(-10px) scale(1.05);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(255,69,0,0.2);
        }

        .community-icon {
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 3rem);
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }

        .community-feature-title {
            font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--white);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .community-feature-text {
            font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 2vw, 1.125rem);
            color: var(--light-smoke);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* Coming Soon Section with Clock Animation */
        .coming-soon {
            padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-sm);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg,
                var(--light-gray) 0%,
                var(--white) 30%,
                var(--off-white) 100%);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .coming-soon-container {
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .coming-soon-title {
            font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 4.5rem);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
            color: var(--black);
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.3) rotateX(90deg);
        }

        .coming-soon-title.visible {
            animation: titleReveal 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards;
        }

        @keyframes titleReveal {
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: scale(1) rotateX(0);
            }
        }

        .coming-soon-date {
            font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
            font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 1.5rem);
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .countdown {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
        }

        .countdown-item {
            text-align: center;
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
            background: var(--white);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
        }

        .countdown-number {
            font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            display: block;
        }

        .countdown-label {
            font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 0.875rem);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            color: var(--asphalt);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        /* Newsletter Section */
        .newsletter {
            padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-sm);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg,
                var(--off-white) 0%,
                var(--light-gray) 50%,
                var(--asphalt) 100%);
        }

        .newsletter-container {
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .newsletter-title {
            font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 3rem);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
            color: var(--black);
        }

        .newsletter-text {
            color: var(--asphalt);
            margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.125rem);
        }

        .newsletter-form {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        @media (min-width: 500px) {
            .newsletter-form {
                flex-direction: row;
            }
        }

        .newsletter-input {
            flex: 1;
            padding: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1rem) clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
            background: var(--white);
            border: 2px solid var(--light-gray);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            color: var(--black);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1rem);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .newsletter-input:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--fire-orange);
        }

        .newsletter-input::placeholder {
            color: var(--smoke);
        }

        .newsletter-button {
            padding: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1rem) clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            color: var(--white);
            font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1rem);
        }

        .newsletter-button:hover {
            background: var(--racing-red);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(220,20,60,0.3);
        }

        /* ===== FOOTER STYLES ===== */
        .Ember-footer {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--steel) 0%, #1a1a1a 20%, var(--black) 100%);
            padding: 80px 0 30px;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.1);
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Top accent line */
        .Ember-footer::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg,
                transparent,
                var(--fire-orange) 20%,
                var(--racing-red) 50%,
                var(--fire-orange) 80%,
                transparent);
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        .Ember-footer-container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 40px;
        }

        /* Main Footer Content */
        .Ember-footer-content {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1.5fr;
            gap: 60px;
            margin-bottom: 60px;
        }

        /* Brand Column */
        .Ember-footer-brand {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 25px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-logo {
            display: inline-block;
            height: 60px;
            width: auto;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-logo img {
            height: 100%;
            width: auto;
            filter: brightness(0.9);
            transition: filter 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-logo:hover img {
            filter: brightness(1.1) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.5));
        }

        .Ember-footer-tagline {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            color: var(--smoke);
            font-style: italic;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-description {
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.8;
            color: var(--smoke);
            max-width: 400px;
        }

        /* Navigation Columns */
        .Ember-footer-nav {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav h3 {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            position: relative;
            padding-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav h3::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            transition: width 0.6s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav h3.animate::after {
            width: 100%;
        }

        /* Special styling for Connect section titles */
        .Ember-footer-connect h3 {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bronze) 0%, var(--bronze-light) 50%, var(--bronze) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            position: relative;
            padding-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-connect h3::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bronze), var(--bronze-light));
            transition: width 0.6s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-connect h3.animate::after {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav ul {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav a {
            color: var(--smoke);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            position: relative;
            display: inline-block;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav a::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -2px;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav a:hover::before {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav a:hover {
            color: var(--white);
            transform: translateX(3px);
        }

        /* Social & Newsletter Column */
        .Ember-footer-connect {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 25px;
        }

        .Ember-social-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 15px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .Ember-social-link {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: 4px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: var(--smoke);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
        }

        .Ember-social-link:hover {
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            border-color: var(--fire-orange);
            color: var(--white);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.3);
        }

        /* Newsletter Signup */
        .Ember-newsletter-mini {
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .Ember-newsletter-form {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 15px;
        }

        .Ember-newsletter-input {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px 15px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 4px;
            color: var(--white);
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-newsletter-input::placeholder {
            color: var(--smoke);
        }

        .Ember-newsletter-input:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--fire-orange);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        }

        .Ember-newsletter-submit {
            padding: 12px 20px;
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            color: var(--white);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 12px;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-newsletter-submit:hover {
            background: var(--racing-red);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.3);
        }

        /* Footer Bottom */
        .Ember-footer-bottom {
            padding-top: 30px;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-copyright {
            color: var(--smoke);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-legal {
            display: flex;
            gap: 30px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .Ember-footer-legal a {
            color: var(--smoke);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-legal a:hover {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */
        @keyframes slideRight {
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes slideLeft {
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes fadeUpStagger {
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        /* ===== RESPONSIVE DESIGN ===== */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .Ember-row {
                padding: 0 24px;
            }
            .Ember-logo {
                height: 62px;
            }
            .manifesto-container {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: var(--space-md);
            }
            .manifesto-visual {
                order: -1;
                max-width: 500px;
                margin: 0 auto;
            }
            .manifesto-content {
                text-align: center;
            }
            .collections-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                max-width: 500px;
                margin: 0 auto;
            }
            .values-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                max-width: 500px;
                margin: 0 auto;
            }
            .community-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
            .Ember-footer-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
                gap: 40px;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .Ember-shell {
                --Ember-header: var(--Ember-header-md);
            }
            .Ember-burger {
                display: block;
            }
            .Ember-nav {
                display: none;
            }
            .Ember-logo {
                height: 56px;
            }
            .Ember-hero {
                height: 72dvh;
                min-height: 540px;
            }
            .Ember-hero .wrap {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                text-align: center;
            }
            .Ember-left {
                align-items: center;
                margin-top: min(8vh, 96px);
            }
            .Ember-copy {
                margin: 0 auto;
            }
            /* keep the GLB consistently top-right on mobile too */
            .Ember-glb {
                top: -10%;
                right: -14%;
                width: clamp(160px, 40vw, 260px);
                height: clamp(160px, 40vw, 260px);
            }
            .community-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                max-width: 400px;
                margin: 0 auto var(--space-lg);
            }
            .countdown {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
            .Ember-footer {
                padding: 60px 0 30px;
            }
            .Ember-footer-container {
                padding: 0 24px;
            }
            .Ember-footer-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 40px;
                text-align: center;
            }
            .Ember-footer-nav h3.animate::after,
            .Ember-footer-connect h3.animate::after {
                left: 50%;
                transform: translateX(-50%);
                width: 100%;
            }
            .Ember-footer-nav ul {
                align-items: center;
            }
            .Ember-social-links {
                justify-content: center;
            }
            .Ember-footer-bottom {
                flex-direction: column;
                text-align: center;
            }
            .Ember-footer-legal {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 15px;
            }
            .Ember-newsletter-form {
                flex-direction: column;
            }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .Ember-shell.is-hero-visible .Ember-title,
            .Ember-shell.is-hero-visible .Ember-copy,
            .Ember-shell.is-hero-visible .Ember-cta,
            .Ember-shell.is-hero-visible .Ember-glb {
                animation: none;
                opacity: 1;
                transform: none;
            }
        }
    </style>
