<title>Built in the Garage — Ember</title>
<!-- Premium Typography -->


<style type="text/css">@font-face {font-family:'Bebas Neue';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(/cf-fonts/s/bebas-neue/5.2.7/latin-ext/400/normal.woff2);unicode-range:U+0100-02BA,U+02BD-02C5,U+02C7-02CC,U+02CE-02D7,U+02DD-02FF,U+0304,U+0308,U+0329,U+1D00-1DBF,U+1E00-1E9F,U+1EF2-1EFF,U+2020,U+20A0-20AB,U+20AD-20C0,U+2113,U+2C60-2C7F,U+A720-A7FF;font-display:swap;}@font-face {font-family:'Bebas Neue';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;src:url(/cf-fonts/s/bebas-neue/5.2.7/latin/400/normal.woff2);unicode-range:U+0000-00FF,U+0131,U+0152-0153,U+02BB-02BC,U+02C6,U+02DA,U+02DC,U+0304,U+0308,U+0329,U+2000-206F,U+20AC,U+2122,U+2191,U+2193,U+2212,U+2215,U+FEFF,U+FFFD;font-display:swap;}</style>
<style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --black: #0a0a0a;
            --steel: #1a1a1a;
            --asphalt: #2a2a2a;
            --smoke: #8a8a8a;
            --light-smoke: #b0b0b0;
            --light-gray: #f0f0f0;
            --off-white: #f8f8f8;
            --white: #ffffff;
            --fire-orange: #ff4500;
            --racing-red: #dc143c;
            --louisiana-gold: #FFD700;
            --bronze: #CD7F32;
            --bronze-light: #E5A558;
            --bronze-dark: #9B5F1F;

            /* Typography */
            --font-display: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'Space Mono', monospace;

            /* Spacing */
            --space-xs: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1rem);
            --space-sm: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.5rem);
            --space-md: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem);
            --space-lg: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5rem);
            --space-xl: clamp(4rem, 9vw, 7rem);

            /* Border Radius */
            --radius: 12px;

            /* Ember Specific Variables */
            --Ember-ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
            --Ember-header: 80px;
            --Ember-header-md: 70px;
            --Ember-maxw: 1440px;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background-color: var(--black);
            color: var(--white);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            line-height: 1.6;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
            -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
        }

        /* ===== HEADER STYLES ===== */
        .Ember-shell {
            --Ember-ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
            --Ember-bronze: #CD7F32;
            --Ember-bronze-light: #E5A558;
            --Ember-bronze-dark: #9B5F1F;
            --Ember-ink: #fff;
            --Ember-muted: #c8cdd2;
            --Ember-orange: #ff4500;
            --Ember-bg0: #0a0a0a;
            --Ember-bg1: #141414;
            --Ember-bg2: #1f1f1f;
            --Ember-header: 80px;
            --Ember-header-md: 70px;
            --Ember-maxw: 1440px;
        }

        .Ember-shell * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        /* ---------- Header (dark everywhere) ---------- */
        .Ember-header {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0 0 auto 0;
            height: var(--Ember-header);
            z-index: 10000;
            background: rgba(10,10,10,.86);
            box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,69,0,.06);
            transition: transform .28s var(--Ember-ease), backdrop-filter .28s var(--Ember-ease), background-color .28s var(--Ember-ease);
            will-change: transform;
        }

        @supports(backdrop-filter:blur(1px)) {
            .Ember-header {
                backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            }
            .Ember-header.is-scrolling {
                backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            }
        }

        .Ember-header.is-hidden {
            transform: translateY(-100%);
        }

        .Ember-row {
            max-width: var(--Ember-maxw);
            margin: 0 auto;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 0 56px;
        }

        .Ember-logo {
            height: 68px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            text-decoration: none;
            position: relative;
            transition: transform .25s var(--Ember-ease);
        }

        .Ember-logo img {
            height: 100%;
            width: auto;
            display: block;
            filter: brightness(.96);
            transition: filter .25s var(--Ember-ease);
        }

        .Ember-logo::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 50%;
            bottom: -6px;
            transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0);
            width: 100%;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--Ember-orange), transparent);
            transition: transform .3s var(--Ember-ease);
        }

        .Ember-logo:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .Ember-logo:hover img {
            filter: brightness(1.1) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,69,0,.4));
        }

        .Ember-logo:hover::after {
            transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1);
        }

        /* Desktop nav (hover/underline everywhere, only current underlined) */
        .Ember-nav {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            gap: 44px;
        }

        .Ember-nav a {
            color: var(--Ember-muted);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 15px;
            letter-spacing: .08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 700;
            position: relative;
            outline: none;
        }

        .Ember-nav a::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: -4px;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--Ember-orange), var(--Ember-bronze-light));
            transform: scaleX(0);
            transition: transform .25s var(--Ember-ease);
            transform-origin: center;
        }

        .Ember-nav a:hover,
        .Ember-nav a.is-active,
        .Ember-nav a:focus-visible {
            color: var(--Ember-ink);
        }

        .Ember-nav a:hover::before,
        .Ember-nav a.is-active::before,
        .Ember-nav a:focus-visible::before {
            transform: scaleX(1);
        }

        /* Burger + Mobile menu with matching underline */
        .Ember-burger {
            display: none;
            background: none;
            border: 0;
            padding: 10px;
            cursor: pointer;
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }

        .Ember-burger span {
            display: block;
            width: 24px;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--Ember-orange);
            margin: 5px 0;
            transition: transform .25s, opacity .25s;
        }

        .Ember-burger.is-open span:nth-child(1) {
            transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 6px);
        }

        .Ember-burger.is-open span:nth-child(2) {
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .Ember-burger.is-open span:nth-child(3) {
            transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(6px, -6px);
        }

        .Ember-mobile {
            position: fixed;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            top: var(--Ember-header);
            background: rgba(15,15,15,.98);
            transform: translateY(-100%);
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: transform .28s var(--Ember-ease), opacity .28s;
            z-index: 9999;
            padding: 22px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,69,0,.14);
        }

        .Ember-mobile.is-open {
            transform: translateY(0);
            opacity: 1;
            visibility: visible;
        }

        .Ember-mobile ul {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 20px;
            margin: 0;
        }

        .Ember-mobile a {
            color: var(--Ember-ink);
            text-decoration: none;
            letter-spacing: .08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 800;
            position: relative;
            outline: none;
            padding: 8px 0;
        }

        .Ember-mobile a::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: -2px;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--Ember-orange), var(--Ember-bronze-light));
            transform: scaleX(0);
            transition: transform .25s var(--Ember-ease);
            transform-origin: center;
        }

        .Ember-mobile a:focus-visible::before,
        .Ember-mobile a:active::before,
        .Ember-mobile a.is-active::before,
        .Ember-mobile a.tap-anim::before {
            transform: scaleX(1);
        }

        /* Spacer for non-home pages */
        .Ember-spacer {
            height: var(--Ember-header);
            display: block;
        }

        /* ===== ABOUT PAGE STYLES ===== */
        :root {
            --steel: #2d2d2d;
            --asphalt: #404040;
            --smoke: #969696;
            --light-gray: #f5f5f5;
            --fire-orange: #ff4500;
            --racing-red: #dc143c;
            --diesel-green: #2d4a2b;
            --coffee-brown: #3e2723;
            --louisiana-gold: #FFD700;
            --warm-gradient-1: #ff6b35;
            --warm-gradient-2: #f77737;

            /* Typography */
            --font-heading: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            --font-subheading: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
        }

        /* Typography Base */
        .about-page h1,
        .about-page h2,
        .about-page h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            letter-spacing: 0.02em;
        }

        .about-page h4,
        .about-page h5,
        .about-page h6 {
            font-family: var(--font-subheading);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .about-page p {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 400;
            letter-spacing: -0.011em;
        }

        /* Hero Section */
        .about-hero {
            position: relative;
            min-height: 70vh;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--black) 0%, var(--steel) 100%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .about-hero::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: url('/theme-packages/ember/2.6.13/preview/assets/generated/theme-mark.svg') center/cover;
            opacity: 0.3;
            transform: translateZ(0);
            will-change: transform;
        }

        .about-hero-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 900px;
            padding: 100px 20px 60px;
        }

        .hero-meta-info {
            margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
            opacity: 0;
            animation: fadeInDown 1s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.2s forwards;
        }

        .hero-meta-info p {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-family: var(--font-subheading);
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 0.2em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin: 8px 0;
            opacity: 0.7;
            transition: color 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .hero-meta-info p.color-animate {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--smoke) 0%, var(--racing-red) 50%, var(--smoke) 100%);
            background-size: 200% 100%;
            background-position: 0% 0%;
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            transition: background-position 1s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .hero-meta-info .divider {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 40px;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--fire-orange), transparent);
            margin: 20px 0;
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        .about-hero-title {
            font-size: clamp(56px, 7vw, 96px);
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--white);
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            line-height: 0.9;
            opacity: 0;
            animation: fadeInUp 1s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.4s forwards;
        }

        .about-hero-subtitle {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--smoke);
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            line-height: 1.7;
            opacity: 0;
            animation: fadeInUp 1s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.6s forwards;
        }

        /* Moment Section */
        .moment-section {
            padding: 120px 40px;
            background: var(--white);
        }

        .moment-container {
            max-width: 1000px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .moment-title {
            font-size: clamp(42px, 5vw, 64px);
            font-weight: 400;
            margin-bottom: 48px;
            color: var(--black);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .moment-story {
            font-size: 17px;
            line-height: 1.8;
            color: var(--asphalt);
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .moment-story strong {
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-family: var(--font-subheading);
        }

        .moment-quote {
            margin: 60px auto;
            padding: 40px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--light-gray), rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.05));
            border-left: 4px solid var(--fire-orange);
            max-width: 700px;
            position: relative;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-30px);
        }

        .moment-quote.visible {
            animation: slideInFromLeft 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards;
        }

        .moment-quote p {
            font-size: 26px;
            font-style: italic;
            font-family: var(--font-subheading);
            color: var(--steel);
            margin: 0;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        /* Video Section */
        .video-section {
            padding: 80px 40px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--white) 0%, var(--light-gray) 100%);
        }

        .video-container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            position: relative;
            padding-bottom: 56.25%;
            height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: var(--black);
        }

        .video-container video {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
        }

        /* Collections Section */
        .collections-section {
            padding: 120px 40px;
            background: var(--light-gray);
        }

        .collections-container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .collections-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 80px;
        }

        .collections-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(42px, 5vw, 64px);
            font-weight: 400;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: var(--black);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .collections-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 40px;
        }

        .collection-card {
            background: var(--white);
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            cursor: pointer;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(40px);
            text-decoration: none;
            display: block;
        }

        .collection-card.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .collection-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-12px);
            box-shadow: 0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
        }

        .collection-image {
            height: 280px;
            background: var(--steel);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .collection-image img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .collection-card:hover .collection-image img {
            transform: scale(1.08);
        }

        .collection-badge {
            position: absolute;
            top: 24px;
            right: 24px;
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            color: var(--white);
            padding: 10px 20px;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-family: var(--font-subheading);
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
        }

        .collection-content {
            padding: 36px;
        }

        .collection-title {
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: 400;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            color: var(--black);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .collection-description {
            color: var(--asphalt);
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            line-height: 1.7;
            font-size: 15px;
        }

        .collection-link {
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-family: var(--font-subheading);
            text-decoration: none;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            font-size: 13px;
            display: inline-block;
        }

        /* Against Section */
        .against-section {
            padding: 120px 40px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg,
                var(--light-gray) 0%,
                var(--steel) 30%,
                var(--steel) 70%,
                var(--asphalt) 100%);
            color: var(--white);
        }

        .against-container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .against-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 80px;
        }

        .against-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(42px, 5vw, 64px);
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--white);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .against-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 60px;
        }

        .against-item {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .against-icon {
            font-size: 48px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            display: inline-block;
            transform: rotate(-10deg);
            opacity: 0.3;
            transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .against-title {
            font-size: 22px;
            font-family: var(--font-subheading);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            position: relative;
            display: inline-block;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .against-title::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            width: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--racing-red);
            transition: width 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            transform: translateY(-50%);
        }

        .against-item:nth-child(1) .against-title::after,
        .against-item:nth-child(3) .against-title::after {
            left: -10%;
        }

        .against-item:nth-child(2) .against-title::after {
            right: -10%;
        }

        .against-title.crossed::after {
            width: 120%;
        }

        .against-description {
            color: var(--smoke);
            line-height: 1.7;
            font-size: 15px;
        }

        /* River Parish Section */
        .lafayette-section {
            padding: 120px 40px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg,
                var(--asphalt) 0%,
                #5a4a3a 20%,
                #8b6914 50%,
                #b8860b 70%,
                var(--louisiana-gold) 85%,
                #f4e5c2 100%);
            position: relative;
        }

        .lafayette-container {
            max-width: 1000px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .lafayette-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            color: var(--black);
            padding: 12px 32px;
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            font-size: 13px;
            border: 2px solid var(--black);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .lafayette-title {
            font-size: clamp(42px, 5vw, 64px);
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--black);
            margin-bottom: 36px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        /* Story Section */
        .full-story-section {
            padding: 120px 40px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg,
                #f4e5c2 0%,
                var(--white) 20%,
                var(--white) 100%);
        }

        .story-section {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 80px;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 100px;
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
        }

        .story-section.reverse {
            direction: rtl;
        }

        .story-section.reverse .story-content {
            direction: ltr;
        }

        .story-image {
            position: relative;
            height: 450px;
            background: var(--steel);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .story-image.vertical {
            height: 600px;
        }

        .story-image img,
        .story-image video {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
        }

        /* Values Section */
        .values-about-section {
            padding: 120px 40px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg,
                var(--white) 0%,
                var(--light-gray) 30%,
                #ffe8e0 70%,
                #ffcfc0 100%);
        }

        .values-about-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 32px;
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .value-about-card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
            padding: 48px 32px;
            text-align: center;
            border: 2px solid transparent;
            transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .value-about-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--fire-orange);
            transform: translateY(-12px);
            box-shadow: 0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
            background: var(--white);
        }

        /* CTA Section */
        .about-cta-section {
            padding: 120px 40px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg,
                #ffcfc0 0%,
                var(--warm-gradient-1) 20%,
                var(--fire-orange) 50%,
                var(--racing-red) 100%);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .about-cta-btn {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 20px 48px;
            background: var(--white);
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            font-size: 14px;
            border-radius: 2px;
            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            margin: 10px;
        }

        .about-cta-btn:hover {
            background: var(--black);
            color: var(--white);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        /* Animations */
        @keyframes fadeInUp {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(30px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes fadeInDown {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(-20px);
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }

        @keyframes slideInFromLeft {
            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
        }

        .animate-on-scroll {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(40px);
            transition: all 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        .animate-on-scroll.visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        /* ===== FOOTER STYLES ===== */
        .Ember-footer {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--steel) 0%, #1a1a1a 20%, var(--black) 100%);
            padding: 80px 0 30px;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.1);
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Top accent line */
        .Ember-footer::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg,
                transparent,
                var(--fire-orange) 20%,
                var(--racing-red) 50%,
                var(--fire-orange) 80%,
                transparent);
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        .Ember-footer-container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 40px;
        }

        /* Main Footer Content */
        .Ember-footer-content {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1.5fr;
            gap: 60px;
            margin-bottom: 60px;
        }

        /* Brand Column */
        .Ember-footer-brand {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 25px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-logo {
            display: inline-block;
            height: 60px;
            width: auto;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-logo img {
            height: 100%;
            width: auto;
            filter: brightness(0.9);
            transition: filter 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-logo:hover img {
            filter: brightness(1.1) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.5));
        }

        .Ember-footer-tagline {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            color: var(--smoke);
            font-style: italic;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-description {
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.8;
            color: var(--smoke);
            max-width: 400px;
        }

        /* Navigation Columns */
        .Ember-footer-nav {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav h3 {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            position: relative;
            padding-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav h3::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            transition: width 0.6s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav h3.animate::after {
            width: 100%;
        }

        /* Special styling for Connect section titles */
        .Ember-footer-connect h3 {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bronze) 0%, var(--bronze-light) 50%, var(--bronze) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            position: relative;
            padding-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-connect h3::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bronze), var(--bronze-light));
            transition: width 0.6s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-connect h3.animate::after {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav ul {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav a {
            color: var(--smoke);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            position: relative;
            display: inline-block;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav a::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -2px;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav a:hover::before {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav a:hover {
            color: var(--white);
            transform: translateX(3px);
        }

        /* Social & Newsletter Column */
        .Ember-footer-connect {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 25px;
        }

        .Ember-social-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 15px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .Ember-social-link {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: 4px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: var(--smoke);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
        }

        .Ember-social-link:hover {
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            border-color: var(--fire-orange);
            color: var(--white);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.3);
        }

        /* Newsletter Signup */
        .fft-newsletter-mini {
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .fft-newsletter-form {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 15px;
        }

        .fft-newsletter-input {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px 15px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 4px;
            color: var(--white);
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .fft-newsletter-input::placeholder {
            color: var(--smoke);
        }

        .fft-newsletter-input:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--fire-orange);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        }

        .fft-newsletter-submit {
            padding: 12px 20px;
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            color: var(--white);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 12px;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .fft-newsletter-submit:hover {
            background: var(--racing-red);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.3);
        }

        /* Footer Bottom */
        .Ember-footer-bottom {
            padding-top: 30px;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-copyright {
            color: var(--smoke);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-legal {
            display: flex;
            gap: 30px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .Ember-footer-legal a {
            color: var(--smoke);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-legal a:hover {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        /* ===== RESPONSIVE DESIGN ===== */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .Ember-row {
                padding: 0 24px;
            }
            .Ember-logo {
                height: 62px;
            }
            .story-section {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 40px;
            }
            .story-section.reverse {
                direction: ltr;
            }
            .values-about-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
            .collections-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .against-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 40px;
            }
            .Ember-footer-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
                gap: 40px;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .Ember-shell {
                --Ember-header: var(--Ember-header-md);
            }
            .Ember-burger {
                display: block;
            }
            .Ember-nav {
                display: none;
            }
            .Ember-logo {
                height: 56px;
            }
            .about-hero-content {
                padding: 80px 20px 40px;
            }
            .values-about-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .Ember-footer {
                padding: 60px 0 30px;
            }
            .Ember-footer-container {
                padding: 0 24px;
            }
            .Ember-footer-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 40px;
                text-align: center;
            }
            .Ember-footer-nav h3.animate::after,
            .Ember-footer-connect h3.animate::after {
                left: 50%;
                transform: translateX(-50%);
                width: 100%;
            }
            .Ember-footer-nav ul {
                align-items: center;
            }
            .Ember-social-links {
                justify-content: center;
            }
            .Ember-footer-bottom {
                flex-direction: column;
                text-align: center;
            }
            .Ember-footer-legal {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 15px;
            }
            .fft-newsletter-form {
                flex-direction: column;
            }
        }
    </style>

sections.name: The Moment Everything Changed
sections.html:
The Moment Everything Changed

3:47 AM. Highway 90. Just outside River Parish.

After pulling a 16-hour shift, watching the sun rise over the Cypress Basin from the seat of my bike, it hit me. I'd spent 20 years trading time for money, thinking someday I'd have enough to finally live. But watching those old-timers at the truck stop — guys who'd "made it" but were too broken or too late to enjoy it — I realized the real luxury wasn't in my bank account.

"Time isn't money. Time is everything money can't buy back."

That morning, Ember Supply was born. Not as a business plan, but as a middle finger to the lie that we should wait until retirement to live. Every piece we make is a reminder: the goal isn't to get rich enough to buy freedom. It's to be free enough to get rich in experiences.

sections.name: The Full Story
sections.html:
The Full Story

Ember Supply isn't backed by investors or focus groups. It started with grease under the fingernails and a realization that hit harder than Louisiana summer heat.

Every thread is sewn with purpose in River Parish — not to save costs, but to build something real in a world of dropshipped dreams.

From that first sunrise on Highway 90 to every late-night garage session since, we've stayed true to one principle: time is the only real currency.

        /* ===== HEADER STYLES ===== */
        .Ember-shell {
            --Ember-ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
            --Ember-bronze: #CD7F32;
            --Ember-bronze-light: #E5A558;
            --Ember-bronze-dark: #9B5F1F;
            --Ember-ink: #fff;
            --Ember-muted: #c8cdd2;
            --Ember-orange: #ff4500;
            --Ember-bg0: #0a0a0a;
            --Ember-bg1: #141414;
            --Ember-bg2: #1f1f1f;
            --Ember-header: 80px;
            --Ember-header-md: 70px;
            --Ember-maxw: 1440px;
        }

        .Ember-shell * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        /* ---------- Header (dark everywhere) ---------- */
        .Ember-header {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0 0 auto 0;
            height: var(--Ember-header);
            z-index: 10000;
            background: rgba(10,10,10,.86);
            box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,69,0,.06);
            transition: transform .28s var(--Ember-ease), backdrop-filter .28s var(--Ember-ease), background-color .28s var(--Ember-ease);
            will-change: transform;
        }

        @supports(backdrop-filter:blur(1px)) {
            .Ember-header {
                backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            }
            .Ember-header.is-scrolling {
                backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            }
        }

        .Ember-header.is-hidden {
            transform: translateY(-100%);
        }

        .Ember-row {
            max-width: var(--Ember-maxw);
            margin: 0 auto;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 0 56px;
        }

        .Ember-logo {
            height: 68px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            text-decoration: none;
            position: relative;
            transition: transform .25s var(--Ember-ease);
        }

        .Ember-logo img {
            height: 100%;
            width: auto;
            display: block;
            filter: brightness(.96);
            transition: filter .25s var(--Ember-ease);
        }

        .Ember-logo::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 50%;
            bottom: -6px;
            transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0);
            width: 100%;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--Ember-orange), transparent);
            transition: transform .3s var(--Ember-ease);
        }

        .Ember-logo:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .Ember-logo:hover img {
            filter: brightness(1.1) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,69,0,.4));
        }

        .Ember-logo:hover::after {
            transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1);
        }

        /* Desktop nav (hover/underline everywhere, only current underlined) */
        .Ember-nav {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            gap: 44px;
        }

        .Ember-nav a {
            color: var(--Ember-muted);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 15px;
            letter-spacing: .08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 700;
            position: relative;
            outline: none;
        }

        .Ember-nav a::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: -4px;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--Ember-orange), var(--Ember-bronze-light));
            transform: scaleX(0);
            transition: transform .25s var(--Ember-ease);
            transform-origin: center;
        }

        .Ember-nav a:hover,
        .Ember-nav a.is-active,
        .Ember-nav a:focus-visible {
            color: var(--Ember-ink);
        }

        .Ember-nav a:hover::before,
        .Ember-nav a.is-active::before,
        .Ember-nav a:focus-visible::before {
            transform: scaleX(1);
        }

        /* Burger + Mobile menu with matching underline */
        .Ember-burger {
            display: none;
            background: none;
            border: 0;
            padding: 10px;
            cursor: pointer;
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }

        .Ember-burger span {
            display: block;
            width: 24px;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--Ember-orange);
            margin: 5px 0;
            transition: transform .25s, opacity .25s;
        }

        .Ember-burger.is-open span:nth-child(1) {
            transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 6px);
        }

        .Ember-burger.is-open span:nth-child(2) {
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .Ember-burger.is-open span:nth-child(3) {
            transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(6px, -6px);
        }

        .Ember-mobile {
            position: fixed;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            top: var(--Ember-header);
            background: rgba(15,15,15,.98);
            transform: translateY(-100%);
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: transform .28s var(--Ember-ease), opacity .28s;
            z-index: 9999;
            padding: 22px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,69,0,.14);
        }

        .Ember-mobile.is-open {
            transform: translateY(0);
            opacity: 1;
            visibility: visible;
        }

        .Ember-mobile ul {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 20px;
            margin: 0;
        }

        .Ember-mobile a {
            color: var(--Ember-ink);
            text-decoration: none;
            letter-spacing: .08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 800;
            position: relative;
            outline: none;
            padding: 8px 0;
        }

        .Ember-mobile a::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: -2px;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--Ember-orange), var(--Ember-bronze-light));
            transform: scaleX(0);
            transition: transform .25s var(--Ember-ease);
            transform-origin: center;
        }

        .Ember-mobile a:focus-visible::before,
        .Ember-mobile a:active::before,
        .Ember-mobile a.is-active::before,
        .Ember-mobile a.tap-anim::before {
            transform: scaleX(1);
        }

        /* Spacer for non-home pages */
        .Ember-spacer {
            height: var(--Ember-header);
            display: block;
        }

        /* ===== COMMUNITY PAGE STYLES ===== */
        :root {
            --steel: #2d2d2d;
            --asphalt: #404040;
            --smoke: #969696;
            --light-gray: #f5f5f5;
            --fire-orange: #ff4500;
            --racing-red: #dc143c;
            --diesel-green: #2d4a2b;
            --coffee-brown: #3e2723;
        }

        /* Community Hero */
        .community-hero {
            position: relative;
            min-height: 70vh;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--black) 0%, var(--steel) 50%, var(--black) 100%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .community-hero::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
        }

        .community-hero-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 1000px;
            padding: 100px 20px 60px;
        }

        .community-hero-title {
            font-size: clamp(48px, 7vw, 90px);
            font-weight: 900;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            line-height: 0.9;
        }

        .community-hero-title span {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--fire-orange) 0%, var(--racing-red) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .community-hero-subtitle {
            font-size: 22px;
            color: var(--smoke);
            max-width: 700px;
            margin: 0 auto 40px;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .community-stats {
            display: flex;
            gap: 60px;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: 50px;
        }

        .stat-item {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .stat-number {
            font-size: 48px;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--smoke);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        /* Events Section */
        .events-section {
            padding: 100px 40px;
            background: var(--white);
        }

        .events-container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .events-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 80px;
        }

        .events-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 56px);
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--black);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .events-header p {
            color: var(--asphalt);
            font-size: 18px;
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .events-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 40px;
        }

        .event-card {
            background: var(--light-gray);
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            cursor: pointer;
            position: relative;
        }

        .event-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-10px);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }

        .event-image {
            height: 250px;
            background: var(--steel);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .event-badge {
            position: absolute;
            top: 20px;
            left: 20px;
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            color: var(--white);
            padding: 8px 20px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 12px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .event-content {
            padding: 40px;
        }

        .event-date {
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .event-title {
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--black);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .event-location {
            color: var(--asphalt);
            font-size: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .event-description {
            color: var(--asphalt);
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 25px;
        }

        .event-link {
            display: inline-block;
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .event-link:hover {
            transform: translateX(5px);
        }

        /* Gallery Section */
        .gallery-section {
            padding: 100px 40px;
            background: var(--steel);
        }

        .gallery-container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .gallery-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 60px;
        }

        .gallery-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 56px);
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--white);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .gallery-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .gallery-item {
            position: relative;
            aspect-ratio: 1;
            background: var(--asphalt);
            overflow: hidden;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .gallery-item:nth-child(3) {
            grid-column: span 2;
            grid-row: span 2;
        }

        .gallery-item:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
            z-index: 10;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }

        .gallery-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            padding: 20px;
            background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.9), transparent);
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(20px);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .gallery-item:hover .gallery-overlay {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .gallery-caption {
            color: var(--white);
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* Join Section */
        .join-section {
            padding: 100px 40px;
            background: var(--white);
        }

        .join-container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .join-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 56px);
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--black);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .join-header p {
            color: var(--asphalt);
            font-size: 18px;
            max-width: 700px;
            margin: 0 auto 60px;
        }

        .join-options {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 40px;
            margin-bottom: 60px;
        }

        .join-card {
            padding: 50px 30px;
            background: var(--light-gray);
            border: 2px solid transparent;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .join-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--fire-orange);
            transform: translateY(-10px);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
        }

        .join-icon {
            font-size: 48px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .join-title {
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--black);
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .join-description {
            color: var(--asphalt);
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        .join-button {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 15px 30px;
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            color: var(--white);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .join-button:hover {
            background: var(--racing-red);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.3);
        }

        /* Stories Section */
        .stories-section {
            padding: 100px 40px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--black) 0%, var(--steel) 100%);
        }

        .stories-container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .stories-header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 60px;
        }

        .stories-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 56px);
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--white);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .stories-carousel {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 40px;
        }

        .story-card {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            padding: 40px 30px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.2);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .story-card:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.1);
            border-color: var(--fire-orange);
            transform: translateY(-5px);
        }

        .story-quote {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--smoke);
            margin-bottom: 25px;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .story-author {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 15px;
        }

        .author-avatar {
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 20px;
        }

        .author-info {
            text-align: left;
        }

        .author-name {
            color: var(--white);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
        }

        .author-role {
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            font-size: 12px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        /* Social Feed */
        .social-section {
            padding: 100px 40px;
            background: var(--white);
        }

        .social-container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .social-header h2 {
            font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 56px);
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--black);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .social-hashtag {
            font-size: 24px;
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 60px;
        }

        .social-cta {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 18px 50px;
            background: var(--black);
            color: var(--white);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .social-cta:hover {
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.3);
        }

        /* ===== FOOTER STYLES ===== */
        .Ember-footer {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--steel) 0%, #1a1a1a 20%, var(--black) 100%);
            padding: 80px 0 30px;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.1);
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Top accent line */
        .Ember-footer::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg,
                transparent,
                var(--fire-orange) 20%,
                var(--racing-red) 50%,
                var(--fire-orange) 80%,
                transparent);
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        .Ember-footer-container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 40px;
        }

        /* Main Footer Content */
        .Ember-footer-content {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1.5fr;
            gap: 60px;
            margin-bottom: 60px;
        }

        /* Brand Column */
        .Ember-footer-brand {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 25px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-logo {
            display: inline-block;
            height: 60px;
            width: auto;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-logo img {
            height: 100%;
            width: auto;
            filter: brightness(0.9);
            transition: filter 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-logo:hover img {
            filter: brightness(1.1) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.5));
        }

        .Ember-footer-tagline {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            color: var(--smoke);
            font-style: italic;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-description {
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.8;
            color: var(--smoke);
            max-width: 400px;
        }

        /* Navigation Columns */
        .Ember-footer-nav {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav h3 {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            color: var(--fire-orange);
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            position: relative;
            padding-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav h3::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            transition: width 0.6s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav h3.animate::after {
            width: 100%;
        }

        /* Special styling for Connect section titles */
        .Ember-footer-connect h3 {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bronze) 0%, var(--bronze-light) 50%, var(--bronze) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            position: relative;
            padding-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-connect h3::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bronze), var(--bronze-light));
            transition: width 0.6s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-connect h3.animate::after {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav ul {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav a {
            color: var(--smoke);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            position: relative;
            display: inline-block;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav a::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -2px;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav a:hover::before {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .Ember-footer-nav a:hover {
            color: var(--white);
            transform: translateX(3px);
        }

        /* Social & Newsletter Column */
        .Ember-footer-connect {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 25px;
        }

        .Ember-social-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 15px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .Ember-social-link {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: 4px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: var(--smoke);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
        }

        .Ember-social-link:hover {
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            border-color: var(--fire-orange);
            color: var(--white);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.3);
        }

        /* Newsletter Signup */
        .fft-newsletter-mini {
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .fft-newsletter-form {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 15px;
        }

        .fft-newsletter-input {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 12px 15px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 4px;
            color: var(--white);
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .fft-newsletter-input::placeholder {
            color: var(--smoke);
        }

        .fft-newsletter-input:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--fire-orange);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        }

        .fft-newsletter-submit {
            padding: 12px 20px;
            background: var(--fire-orange);
            color: var(--white);
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 12px;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .fft-newsletter-submit:hover {
            background: var(--racing-red);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.3);
        }

        /* Footer Bottom */
        .Ember-footer-bottom {
            padding-top: 30px;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-copyright {
            color: var(--smoke);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .Ember-footer-legal {
            display: flex;
            gap: 30px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .Ember-footer-legal a {
            color: var(--smoke);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 14px;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .Ember-footer-legal a:hover {
            color: var(--white);
        }

        /* ===== RESPONSIVE DESIGN ===== */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .Ember-row {
                padding: 0 24px;
            }
            .Ember-logo {
                height: 62px;
            }
            .events-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .gallery-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
            .join-options {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .Ember-footer-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
                gap: 40px;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .Ember-shell {
                --Ember-header: var(--Ember-header-md);
            }
            .Ember-burger {
                display: block;
            }
            .Ember-nav {
                display: none;
            }
            .Ember-logo {
                height: 56px;
            }
            .community-stats {
                gap: 30px;
            }
            .stories-carousel {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .gallery-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .gallery-item:nth-child(3) {
                grid-column: span 1;
                grid-row: span 1;
            }
            .Ember-footer {
                padding: 60px 0 30px;
            }
            .Ember-footer-container {
                padding: 0 24px;
            }
            .Ember-footer-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 40px;
                text-align: center;
            }
            .Ember-footer-nav h3.animate::after,
            .Ember-footer-connect h3.animate::after {
                left: 50%;
                transform: translateX(-50%);
                width: 100%;
            }
            .Ember-footer-nav ul {
                align-items: center;
            }
            .Ember-social-links {
                justify-content: center;
            }
            .Ember-footer-bottom {
                flex-direction: column;
                text-align: center;
            }
            .Ember-footer-legal {
                flex-direction: column;
                gap: 15px;
            }
            .fft-newsletter-form {
                flex-direction: column;
            }
