<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><base href="https://themes.inneranimalmedia.com/theme-packages/ember/2.6.13/preview/"><title>Pit Stop Zip Hoodie</title><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;900&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"><style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --black: #0a0a0a;
            --steel: #1a1a1a;
            --asphalt: #2a2a2a;
            --smoke: #8a8a8a;
            --light-smoke: #b0b0b0;
            --light-gray: #f0f0f0;
            --off-white: #f8f8f8;
            --white: #ffffff;
            --fire-orange: #ff4500;
            --racing-red: #dc143c;
            --louisiana-gold: #FFD700;
            --bronze: #CD7F32;
            --bronze-light: #E5A558;
            --bronze-dark: #9B5F1F;

            /* Typography */
            --font-display: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'Space Mono', monospace;

            /* Spacing */
            --space-xs: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1rem);
            --space-sm: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.5rem);
            --space-md: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem);
            --space-lg: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5rem);
            --space-xl: clamp(4rem, 9vw, 7rem);

            /* Border Radius */
            --radius: 12px;

            /* Ember Specific Variables */
            --Ember-ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
            --Ember-header: 80px;
            --Ember-header-md: 70px;
            --Ember-maxw: 1440px;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background-color: var(--black);
            color: var(--white);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            line-height: 1.6;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
            -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
        }

        /* ===== HEADER STYLES ===== */
        .Ember-shell {
            --Ember-ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
            --Ember-bronze: #CD7F32;
            --Ember-bronze-light: #E5A558;
            --Ember-bronze-dark: #9B5F1F;
            --Ember-ink: #fff;
            --Ember-muted: #c8cdd2;
            --Ember-orange: #ff4500;
            --Ember-bg0: #0a0a0a;
            --Ember-bg1: #141414;
            --Ember-bg2: #1f1f1f;
            --Ember-header: 80px;
            --Ember-header-md: 70px;
            --Ember-maxw: 1440px;
        }

        .Ember-shell * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        /* ---------- Header (dark everywhere) ---------- */
        .Ember-header {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0 0 auto 0;
            height: var(--Ember-header);
            z-index: 10000;
            background: rgba(10,10,10,.86);
            box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,69,0,.06);
            transition: transform .28s var(--Ember-ease), backdrop-filter .28s var(--Ember-ease), background-color .28s var(--Ember-ease);
            will-change: transform;
        }

        @supports(backdrop-filter:blur(1px)) {
            .Ember-header {
                backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            }
            .Ember-header.is-scrolling {
                backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            }
        }

        .Ember-header.is-hidden {
            transform: translateY(-100%);
        }

        .Ember-row {
            max-width: var(--Ember-maxw);
            margin: 0 auto;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 0 56px;
        }

        .Ember-logo {
            height: 68px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            text-decoration: none;
            position: relative;
            transition: transform .25s var(--Ember-ease);
        }

        .Ember-logo img {
            height: 100%;
            width: auto;
            display: block;
            filter: brightness(.96);
            transition: filter .25s var(--Ember-ease);
        }

        .Ember-logo::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 50%;
            bottom: -6px;
            transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0);
            width: 100%;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--Ember-orange), transparent);
            transition: transform .3s var(--Ember-ease);
        }

        .Ember-logo:hover {
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .Ember-logo:hover img {
            filter: brightness(1.1) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,69,0,.4));
        }

        .Ember-logo:hover::after {
            transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1);
        }

        /* Desktop nav (hover/underline everywhere, only current underlined) */
        .Ember-nav {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            gap: 44px;
        }

        .Ember-nav a {
            color: var(--Ember-muted);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 15px;
            letter-spacing: .08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 700;
            position: relative;
            outline: none;
        }

        .Ember-nav a::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: -4px;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--Ember-orange), var(--Ember-bronze-light));
            transform: scaleX(0);
            transition: transform .25s var(--Ember-ease);
            transform-origin: center;
        }

        .Ember-nav a:hover,
        .Ember-nav a.is-active,
        .Ember-nav a:focus-visible {
            color: var(--Ember-ink);
        }

        .Ember-nav a:hover::before,
        .Ember-nav a.is-active::before,
        .Ember-nav a:focus-visible::before {
            transform: scaleX(1);
        }

        /* Burger + Mobile menu with matching underline */
        .Ember-burger {
            display: none;
            background: none;
            border: 0;
            padding: 10px;
            cursor: pointer;
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }

        .Ember-burger span {
            display: block;
            width: 24px;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--Ember-orange);
            margin: 5px 0;
            transition: transform .25s, opacity .25s;
        }

        .Ember-burger.is-open span:nth-child(1) {
            transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 6px);
        }

        .Ember-burger.is-open span:nth-child(2) {
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .Ember-burger.is-open span:nth-child(3) {
            transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(6px, -6px);
        }

        .Ember-mobile {
            position: fixed;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            top: var(--Ember-header);
            background: rgba(15,15,15,.98);
            transform: translateY(-100%);
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: transform .28s var(--Ember-ease), opacity .28s;
            z-index: 9999;
            padding: 22px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,69,0,.14);
        }

        .Ember-mobile.is-open {
            transform: translateY(0);
            opacity: 1;
            visibility: visible;
        }

        .Ember-mobile ul {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 20px;
            margin: 0;
        }

        .Ember-mobile a {
            color: var(--Ember-ink);
            text-decoration: none;
            letter-spacing: .08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 800;
            position: relative;
            outline: none;
            padding: 8px 0;
        }

        .Ember-mobile a::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: -2px;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--Ember-orange), var(--Ember-bronze-light));
            transform: scaleX(0);
            transition: transform .25s var(--Ember-ease);
            transform-origin: center;
        }

        .Ember-mobile a:focus-visible::before,
        .Ember-mobile a:active::before,
        .Ember-mobile a.is-active::before,
        .Ember-mobile a.tap-anim::before {
            transform: scaleX(1);
        }

        /* Spacer for non-home pages */
        .Ember-spacer {
            height: var(--Ember-header);
            display: block;
        }

        /* ===== SHOP PAGE STYLES ===== */
        #fft-shop-hybrid {
            /* Core palette (dynamic; chips/collections can override these) */
            --ink: #ffffff;
            --ink-sub: rgba(255,255,255,.82);
            --bg: #0f1113;          /* base underlay */
            --steel: #2d2d2d;
            --asphalt: #1a1c1f;
            --card: #15181b;
            --line: #22262a;
            --accent: #ff4500;
            --accent-2: #dc143c;
            --muted: #9aa3ac;
            --radius: 18px;
            --shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.24);

            /* ===== Spacing Scale ===== */
            --space-0: 0;
            --space-1: 4px;
            --space-2: 8px;
            --space-3: 12px;
            --space-4: 16px;
            --space-5: 20px;
            --space-6: 24px;
            --space-7: 32px;
            --space-8: 40px;

            /* Container paddings */
            --pad-x: var(--space-3);
            --pad-y: var(--space-4);

            /* Extra hero headroom (tweak here) */
            --hero-top-pad: clamp(18px, 5vw, 48px);
        }

        #fft-shop-hybrid * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        #fft-shop-hybrid .u-m-0 {
            margin: 0!important;
        }

        #fft-shop-hybrid .u-p-0 {
            padding: 0!important;
        }

        #fft-shop-hybrid .u-gap-0 {
            gap: 0!important;
        }

        #fft-shop-hybrid .u-mx-auto {
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
        }

        #fft-shop-hybrid .u-hide {
            display: none!important;
        }

        @media (max-width: 640px) {
            #fft-shop-hybrid {
                --pad-x: var(--space-2);
                --pad-y: var(--space-3);
                --space-6: 16px;
                --space-7: 20px;
                --space-8: 24px;
                --hero-top-pad: 16px;
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 960px) {
            #fft-shop-hybrid {
                --pad-x: var(--space-6);
                --pad-y: var(--space-7);
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 1240px) {
            #fft-shop-hybrid {
                --pad-x: var(--space-8);
                --pad-y: var(--space-8);
            }
        }

        .fft-hybrid-wrap {
            max-width: 1240px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: var(--pad-y) var(--pad-x);
            position: relative;
        }

        /* ===== Carbon fiber background (subtle) ===== */
        #fft-shop-hybrid .fft-hybrid-texture {
            position: relative;
            isolation: isolate;
        }

        #fft-shop-hybrid .fft-hybrid-texture::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: -2;
            background:
                /* cross-hatch carbon weave */
                repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #111416 0 6px, #0b0d0f 6px 12px),
                repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #0f1214 0 6px, #0a0c0e 6px 12px);
            opacity: .9;
        }

        #fft-shop-hybrid .fft-hybrid-texture::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: -1;
            background:
                radial-gradient(1600px 800px at 10% -20%, rgba(255,69,0,.06), transparent 60%),
                linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,.2), rgba(0,0,0,.6));
            mix-blend: overlay;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ================= COUNTDOWN KPI STRIP ================= */
        .fft-countdown {
            margin-top: var(--hero-top-pad);
            margin-bottom: clamp(14px, 3.2vw, 22px);
            display: grid;
            gap: var(--space-3);
            color: var(--ink);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .fft-countdown .row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: stretch;
            gap: var(--space-3);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .fft-kpi {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10,12,14,.7), rgba(8,10,12,.5));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
            border-radius: 14px;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            min-width: 92px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.35), 0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
        }

        .fft-kpi small {
            display: block;
            color: var(--muted);
            letter-spacing: .14em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .fft-seg {
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
            font-feature-settings: "tnum";
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: .06em;
            font-size: clamp(28px, 6vw, 52px);
            line-height: 1;
            color: #e7f1ff;
            text-shadow:
                0 0 4px rgba(231,241,255,.45),
                0 0 12px rgba(255,69,0,.25);
        }

        .fft-sep {
            padding: 0 .2em;
            opacity: .65;
            font-size: clamp(22px, 5vw, 42px);
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(255,69,0,.2));
        }

        .fft-kpi-note {
            font-size: .92rem;
            color: var(--ink-sub);
        }

        /* ================= HERO ================= */
        .fft-hybrid-hero {
            position: relative;
            border-radius: calc(var(--radius) + 6px);
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            margin: var(--space-6) 0;
        }

        .fft-hybrid-hero-media {
            position: relative;
            aspect-ratio: 16/7;
            background: #0c0e10;
            transform: translateZ(0);
        }

        .fft-hybrid-hero-media img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            filter: saturate(1.05) contrast(1.08);
            will-change: transform;
        }

        .fft-hybrid-hero::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,.35), rgba(0,0,0,.75));
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .fft-hybrid-hero-content {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            display: flex;
            align-items: end;
            padding: var(--space-6);
        }

        .fft-hybrid-hero-card {
            background: rgba(13,15,17,.65);
            backdrop-filter: saturate(140%) blur(6px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: var(--space-5) var(--space-6);
            max-width: 820px;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .fft-eyebrow {
            letter-spacing: .16em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: .78rem;
            opacity: .95;
        }

        .fft-hero-title {
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: clamp(28px, 4.4vw, 48px);
            line-height: 1.05;
            margin: .35rem 0 .5rem;
        }

        .fft-hero-sub {
            color: var(--ink-sub);
        }

        .fft-cta-row {
            margin-top: var(--space-3);
            display: flex;
            gap: var(--space-2);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .fft-btn {
            appearance: none;
            border: 0;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-weight: 900;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .fft-btn.accent {
            background: var(--accent);
            color: #fff;
        }

        .fft-btn.ghost {
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);
            color: #fff;
        }

        .fft-gauge {
            height: 10px;
            margin: var(--space-4) 0 0;
            border-radius: 999px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: #0c0e10;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
        }

        .fft-gauge::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background:
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,69,0,.9), rgba(255,69,0,.25)),
                repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 22px, rgba(255,255,255,.18) 22px 24px);
            mix-blend: screen;
        }

        /* ================= COLLECTIONS STRIP ================= */
        .fft-collections {
            margin: var(--space-7) 0 var(--space-2);
        }

        .fft-collections-rail {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: var(--space-3);
        }

        @media (max-width: 960px) {
            .fft-collections-rail {
                display: flex;
                gap: var(--space-3);
                overflow-x: auto;
                -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
                scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
                padding-bottom: var(--space-2);
            }
            .fft-collection {
                min-width: 78%;
                scroll-snap-align: center;
            }
        }

        .fft-collection {
            position: relative;
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            overflow: hidden;
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            display: block;
        }

        .fft-collection-media {
            position: relative;
            aspect-ratio: 4/3;
            background: #0d0f12;
        }

        .fft-collection-media img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
            transition: transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.2,1);
        }

        .fft-collection:hover .fft-collection-media img {
            transform: scale(1.06);
        }

        .fft-collection-tag {
            position: absolute;
            top: 14px;
            left: 14px;
            background: var(--accent);
            color: #fff;
            padding: 6px 10px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            font-size: .72rem;
            letter-spacing: .08em;
            font-weight: 900;
        }

        .fft-collection-body {
            padding: var(--space-4);
        }

        .fft-collection-title {
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            margin: 0 0 6px;
        }

        .fft-collection-kicker {
            color: var(--muted);
            font-size: .95rem;
        }

        .fft-collection-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            display: flex;
            align-items: end;
            padding: 16px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(0,0,0,.78));
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity .35s ease;
        }

        .fft-collection:hover .fft-collection-overlay {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .fft-collection-tagline {
            background: rgba(0,0,0,.65);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
            color: #fff;
            padding: 10px 12px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: .04em;
        }

        /* ================= STORY STAGGERS ================= */
        .fft-stories {
            margin: var(--space-6) 0 var(--space-2);
        }

        .fft-story {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr;
            gap: var(--space-3);
            align-items: stretch;
            margin: var(--space-4) 0;
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            background: var(--card);
        }

        .fft-story.reverse {
            grid-template-columns: .9fr 1.1fr;
        }

        .fft-story-media {
            min-height: 280px;
            background: #0d0f12;
        }

        .fft-story-media img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
        }

        .fft-story-body {
            padding: var(--space-5);
        }

        .fft-story-eyebrow {
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: .12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: .78rem;
        }

        .fft-story-title {
            font-size: 1.35rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            margin: 6px 0 8px;
        }

        .fft-story-copy {
            color: var(--ink-sub);
        }

        @media (max-width: 920px) {
            .fft-story,
            .fft-story.reverse {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        /* ================= STICKY FILTERS / GRID / NEWS ================= */
        .fft-filters-wrap {
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 6;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0c0e10, #0c0e10e6);
            backdrop-filter: saturate(140%) blur(6px);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
        }

        .fft-filters {
            display: flex;
            gap: var(--space-3);
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: var(--space-3) 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .fft-chips,
        .fft-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: var(--space-2);
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .fft-chip {
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            background: #0e1114;
            color: #fff;
            padding: 8px 12px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .fft-chip.active {
            border-color: var(--accent);
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .fft-search {
            position: relative;
        }

        .fft-search input {
            padding: 10px 14px 10px 36px;
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            background: #0e1114;
            color: #fff;
            border-radius: 10px;
            width: 240px;
        }

        .fft-search svg {
            position: absolute;
            left: 10px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            opacity: .6;
        }

        .fft-sort,
        .fft-price-range,
        .fft-select {
            padding: 10px 14px;
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: #0e1114;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .fft-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
            gap: var(--space-3);
            margin: var(--space-4) 0 var(--space-8);
        }

        .fft-card {
            grid-column: span 6;
            background: var(--card);
            border: 1px solid var(--line);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        @media (min-width: 720px) {
            .fft-card {
                grid-column: span 4;
            }
        }

        @media (min-width: 1040px) {
            .fft-card {
                grid-column: span 3;
            }
        }

        .fft-media {
            position: relative;
            aspect-ratio: 1/1;
            background: #0d0f12;
        }

        .fft-media img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
        }

        .fft-img.skeleton::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.06), rgba(255,255,255,.02), rgba(255,255,255,.06));
            animation: fft-shimmer 1.2s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes fft-shimmer {
            0% {
                transform: translateX(-100%);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateX(100%);
            }
        }

        .fft-badges {
            position: absolute;
            left: 10px;
            top: 10px;
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .fft-badge {
            background: var(--accent);
            color: #fff;
            padding: 6px 8px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            font-size: .72rem;
